errors: The trial needs at least two arms.
Decision: the one-sided significance level must be between 0 and 0.5.

warnings: The control arm has a dose above 0: it is simulated as an active arm and the treatment effect is measured against it.
Adherence: the spread is too large for this mean; it is reduced to the largest possible value.
The sign of Emax is the opposite of the benefit direction: the drug would make the endpoint worse.
Decision: the Go threshold is above the No-Go threshold; usually the lower reference value (LRV) is the Go threshold and the target value (TV) the No-Go threshold.
